official_sources: Surrey delivery of development highway works

official_measurement_examples.name: S38 purpose
official_measurement_examples.fact: Section 38 agreements provide a route for a highway authority to adopt qualifying new roads after required standards and agreement conditions are satisfied; an agreement alone does not mean adoption is already complete.

official_measurement_examples.name: S278 purpose
official_measurement_examples.fact: Section 278 agreements govern developer works on an existing public highway and are distinct from the Section 38 adoption process for new roads.

official_measurement_examples.name: Planning separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Planning permission and highway adoption are separate stages; current authority guidance commonly expects planning permission before S38 technical/legal completion but permission does not itself adopt the road.

official_measurement_examples.name: Private-until-adopted
official_measurement_examples.fact: Local highway-authority guidance confirms roads remain private or developer-maintained until final adoption/certificate requirements are satisfied.

official_measurement_examples.name: Technical acceptance limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Technical acceptance, inspection or an executed agreement does not by itself prove final adoption or transfer of every maintenance responsibility.

official_measurement_examples.name: Ownership distinction
official_measurement_examples.fact: Highway adoption or maintainability at public expense is not equivalent to proving freehold ownership of the highway land or adjoining parcel.

official_measurement_examples.name: 2026 local criteria
official_measurement_examples.fact: 2026 highway-authority guidance shows local design standards, fees, bonds, commuted sums and process details vary by authority and must not be inferred from another authority's agreement.

official_measurement_examples.name: Parcel limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Road adoption status does not establish planning permission, access rights over all adjoining land, development capacity or final parcel yield.

core_rules: S38 agreement is not final adoption
planning permission is not road adoption
road remains private until final adoption where applicable
technical acceptance is not final adoption
adoption is not freehold title proof
local authority standards and bonds remain authority-specific
adopted highway status is not unrestricted access right over adjoining parcel
highway agreement does not calculate development yield
historic agreement status must not be treated as current adoption
no parcel highway-adoption clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
source_verification_note: Official DfT, legislation.gov.uk and English highway-authority sources checked 2026-07-26. 2026 local guidance retained with S38/S278, planning, technical acceptance, maintenance and ownership separation; no parcel promotion.
